name: Royal Oak Medical Devices
old_description: Royal Oak Medical stands at the forefront of precision and innovation within the medical device industry.
about:
Royal Oak Medical Devices operates an 18,000-square-foot facility in Rochester Hills, Michigan, which opened in 2013. The company is privately held; no founders are named in public materials.

The company manufactures medical implants, FDA 510(k)-cleared devices, and precision components, working with materials such as titanium, cobalt chrome, stainless steel, PEEK, and thermoplastics. Production processes include multi-axis CNC turning and milling, wire EDM, ultrasonic washing with pharma-grade water, laser marking, and proprietary surface finishing. The facility supports prototyping through full-scale production and features lights-out manufacturing and automated vision inspection.

Royal Oak Medical serves the medical device industry, providing bespoke solutions for original equipment manufacturers and developers of implantable and surgical products. Its in-house design, engineering, and consulting teams collaborate with clients from concept through regulatory submission.

The company emphasizes its quality certifications—ISO 13485:2016 with design, 21 CFR Part 820 compliance, and FDA registration—as differentiators that enable it to meet stringent regulatory requirements for implantable devices.
